import html # Predefined HTML template for a blog post BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def create_blog_post(heading: str, text: str) -> str: """ Prepare a user-submitted blog post for safe web display. Parameters ---------- heading : str The main heading or subject of the blog post. text : str The complete textual content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A sanitized and HTML-formatted blog post ready for presentation. """ # Escape user input to prevent XSS safe_heading = html.escape(heading, quote=True) safe_text = html.escape(text, quote=True) # Render the template with escaped content return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_heading, body=safe_text)
